author: reek
body: The scene pass of the bloom demo: three bright coloured orbs orbiting on a dark field, one GPU thread per pixel. Each orb has a sharp bright core (its falloff cubed) so the highlights blow out to full white-hot colour -- exactly what the bloom pass will bleed into a glow. Output is a packed-RGB framebuffer that the second pass reads. Float falloff from DeviceMath.
